audit.why: 61.4% over 57 games — the strongest number in this slice. The chart concedes only the two-item mark, which is a fair read of a lane you win on range.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why writes 'Between the Worlds' and never names Stormbringer.
audit.why: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1, the longest ultimate cooldown you will face in this lane, and it disables your tower on landing — that is what makes his dive work and why baiting it is worth more than dodging it.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why names both ultimates and gives the 160s.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says he uses 'E (Sky Splitter) to leap onto you'. Sky Splitter is not a leap.
audit.why: Sky Splitter (E, flat 16s, 1200 range) calls a lightning bolt down at a location, damaging and slowing, and shields him only if he is standing inside the blast himself. It is his ranged poke and his self-shield — the only leap in his kit is Stormbringer at 6. Telling the reader to expect an E gap-close means they hold Across the Veil for a dash that does not exist. Separately, Frenzied Maul (W) is a flat 5 seconds, applies on-hit effects and heals him on the second cast against the same target — that 5s heal, not his Q, is what wins him extended trades, and it is why Grievous Wounds matters and why attack speed makes him hurt more than raw armour suggests.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten to Sky Splitter's real behaviour; cooldown block rebuilt on Frenzied Maul's 5s and Thundering Smash's 12s auto-reset.
